stem.text: A rectangular block of steel supporting a very large component of a bridge has a height of $15\,\text{cm}$ and a cross-section of $20\,\text{cm} \times 12\,\text{cm}$. It is designed to compress $1\,\text{mm}$ when under maximum, evenly distributed, load.
The Young modulus of steel is $2.0 \times 10^{11}\,\text{N m}^{-2}$.
What is the maximum load it can support?
